Umsatz.title: Turnover
Umsatz.body: Turnover shows a period's turnover from your books: turnover excl. VAT, VAT from settlements, sales, payouts and what is still to book, each against the previous period or year, plus by month, source and customer. Hover a figure to see where it comes from. A payout is never turnover. Below are your payment processor's events before they are booked: ignore what should stay off the books or include it again, with no reason; TILL keeps who and when. When something is ready to book, the bar with Book appears at the bottom. Without a source, load a file or connect one. Rules holds the template, the behaviour and the bank's booking rules.
